title: The Kingdom Has Options
summary:
Saudi Arabia is using alternative export outlets
Saudi Arabia is the dominant player in the OPEC cartel. It has the highest export quota and the most spare capacity. That is why pundits always look at the Kingdon to try to determine where OPEC policy might be heading.
